mission: Browser security update (owner t537, 2026-11-19 20:42 MYT, content-pipeline ops/decisions.md L568; AMBER per owner rule t479u): both collectors move from Playwright 1.61.0 to Playwright 1.65.2 (exact pin) in services/snkrdunk_collector/requirements.txt and services/yuyutei_collector/requirements.txt, and both collector Dockerfiles move to mcr.microsoft.com/playwright/python:v1.65.2-noble pinned by multi-arch index digest sha256:38dd67fc654b56b3cba611e4c8eb71cd33750e1cd29eea2a5dc00b484817a75f (read 2026-11-19). The bundled Chromium moves from 149.0.7827.55 to 159.0.8154.6 (read from the Playwright package browsers.json). Each Dockerfile also launches the browser once at build time and prints its version in the build log. Chromium sandbox stays off (tested, see the PR). DATA lane (build supply chain). Draft: the owner marks it ready, which releases both collectors.

impacts.reason: Collector images install playwright 1.65.2 instead of 1.61.0. Infrastructure: mission-scoped sequential re-upload of the SNKRDUNK collector and the 9 Yuyu-Tei shards.

Collector base image moves from v1.61.0-noble to v1.65.2-noble pinned by index digest sha256:38dd67fc654b56b3cba611e4c8eb71cd33750e1cd29eea2a5dc00b484817a75f (Python 3.12, Ubuntu 24.04 unchanged), plus a build-time browser launch that prints the Chromium version. Released with the same sequential collector re-upload.

routes: No new route. No extra source request from this change.
impact.deployment_impact: Each collector is re-uploaded on the merge commit in its own slot, with automatic rollback to the deployment captured before upload. Must start 06:00-22:59 UTC; team rule: collector deliveries only 14:00 to 03:00 MYT. services/api is not changed, so the API does not rebuild. No schema change.

recovery.procedure: The rollout captures each collector's live deployment before upload and restores it on failure (recovery_deployment_id rows are reference only, carried from the last full-fleet mission grok-freshness-deadline). Afterwards collector-redeploy to the fleet pin. Code: native revert PR with its own mission file (one more collector release back to Playwright 1.61.0).
recovery.trigger: A collector failing to launch the browser after release, a rise in browser launch or page timeouts in collector logs, or a change in capture results on the post-release due runs.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema change and no row written by this PR.

verification.observation_window: Delivery verify, including natural collector receipts on the merge commit. Then one SNKRDUNK and one Yuyu-Tei due run on staging read back from the run log, then the version-record follow-up (docs/agent/STAGING_FLEET.json) merges before anything else is armed.
